{"toolsets":{"EditorToolset.LevelToolset":{"name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset","version":"1.0","description":"Provides tools for working with the currently loaded level, including loading levels, placing,
replacing, and removing actors, organizing and hiding actors in the outliner, looking up an OFPA
actor's asset path, and managing the world's data layers.","tools":[{"description":"Unloads a level instance's level.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.UnloadLevelInstance","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Unloads previously loaded World Partition actors from the editor.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.UnloadActors","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Traces a line through the world and returns the distance to the first hit.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.TraceWorld","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Shows or hides the actor in the editor viewport and outliner.

This is the same transient, editor-only visibility toggled by the outliner's eye icon; it
does not affect gameplay visibility and does not dirty the level.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.SetActorHidden","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Assigns an actor to the specified folder in the outliner.

Creates the folder implicitly if it does not already exist. Pass an empty string to move
the actor to the root of the outliner.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.SetActorFolder","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Saves the actor to disk.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.SaveActor","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Replaces actors in the scene with new instances of a native Actor class, matching the
editor's "Replace Selected Actors With..." command.

Preserves each actor's world transform, World Partition identity (actor guid and external
package), and layers, and reattaches its former parent and children. Does not preserve the
outliner folder path, Actor tags, or data layer assignments.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.ReplaceActorsWithClass","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Replaces actors in the scene with new actors created from an asset (e.g. a static mesh,
Blueprint, or particle system), matching the editor's "Replace Selected Actors With..."
command.

Preserves each actor's world transform, World Partition identity (actor guid and external
package), and layers, and reattaches its former parent and children. Does not preserve the
outliner folder path, Actor tags, or data layer assignments.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.ReplaceActorsWithAsset","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Renames a folder in the outliner. Applies to the world's own folders only.

Updates the folder path for all actors in the folder and any sub-folders. For example,
renaming "Lighting" to "Lights" also updates actors in "Lighting/Spotlights" to
"Lights/Spotlights". If the new path already exists then the affected actors will be merged
into it.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.RenameFolder","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Deletes an actor from the scene.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.RemoveFromScene","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Removes actors from a data layer. Actors not in the layer are left unchanged.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.RemoveActorsFromDataLayer","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Merges multiple StaticMesh actors into a single mesh asset and actor.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.MergeActors","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Loads a level instance's level, making its actors available as loaded actors.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.LoadLevelInstance","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Loads a level in the editor, closing the current one.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.LoadLevel","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Loads the actors described by the given descriptors into the editor and returns them.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.LoadActors","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Returns whether a level instance's level is loaded. Level instances created by other tools, or
that came with a loaded level, finish loading some time after those tools return.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.IsLevelInstanceLoaded","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns whether the actor is hidden in the editor viewport and outliner.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.IsActorHidden","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns the level instance that directly contains an actor, loaded or not.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.GetParentLevelInstance","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns all folders currently in use in the outliner, including those inside level instances.

Includes all intermediate parent paths. For example, if an actor is assigned to
"Lighting/Spotlights", both "Lighting" and "Lighting/Spotlights" are returned.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.GetFolders","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns the data layer instances in the current world.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.GetDataLayers","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns the path to the current level asset.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.GetCurrentLevel","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns all available collision channels, for use in collision-based actor searches.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.GetCollisionChannels","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns descriptors for the actors in the specified outliner folder.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.GetActorsInFolder","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns descriptors for the loaded actors assigned to a data layer.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.GetActorsInDataLayer","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns the content path that identifies this actor on disk.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.GetActorAssetPath","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Searches the scene for actors that match specific criteria. Actors removed from the scene
are not returned, even before the level is saved.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.FindActors","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Opens a level instance for editing.

While in edit mode, scene tools that add and remove actors operate within the level
instance's sub-level. Only one level instance can be in edit mode at a time. Commit the
level instance when done to save or discard changes.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.EditLevelInstance","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Returns a human-readable text diff between two scene asset packages, each expected to
contain a single external actor.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.Diff","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Deletes a folder from the outliner. Applies to the world's own folders only.

Actors directly in the folder are moved to the parent folder. Sub-folders and their actors
are preserved by re-rooting them under the parent. For example, deleting "Lighting" with a
sub-folder "Lighting/Spotlights" leaves "Spotlights" intact under the parent.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.DeleteFolder","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Creates a Level Instance actor in the scene referencing an existing level asset.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.CreateLevelInstance","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Creates a new empty level asset and opens it in the editor.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.CreateLevel","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Creates a new Data Layer asset in the content browser.

A Data Layer asset is reusable across levels; assign it to actors in the current world by
adding them to the data layer.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.CreateDataLayerAsset","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Saves or discards edits to a level instance and exits edit mode.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.CommitLevelInstance","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Creates a new instance of the specified Actor class at the specified transform. A class the project's class filter hides is refused.
An actor of that class may still be placeable through an asset the project exposes that spawns it, with AddToSceneFromAsset,
and a project toolset may offer the lookup from the class to that asset.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.AddToSceneFromClass","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Creates a new actor in the scene from an asset. An asset the project's permissions hide is refused like a missing one.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.AddToSceneFromAsset","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Adds actors to a data layer, creating its instance in the current world if it has none yet.
Actors already in the layer are left unchanged.","name":"EditorToolset.LevelToolset.AddActorsToDataLayer","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}}]},"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset":{"name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset","version":"1.0","description":"Tools for querying and modifying Unreal Editor state: asset imaging,
actor, asset, and asset-editor selection, scene outliner folder selection, viewport camera,
content browser navigation, content browser collections, and Play-In-Editor session control.","tools":[{"description":"Converts a world-space position into normalized screen space based on the editor viewport camera.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.WorldPosToScreenCoords","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Stops PIE or simulation and waits for shutdown. Normally handled on an editor tick;
pending online login defers shutdown until a world exists. Errors if no session is active.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.StopPIE","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Starts PIE or simulation in the current level, then waits for warmup.
Local single-player worlds usually exist at PostPIEStarted; deferred online
login delays warmup until a world exists. The whole request has a 30-second timeout.
Errors if a session is active or queued.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.StartPIE","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Shows a transient editor notification (Slate toast, bottom-right).","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.ShowNotification","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Sets the view mode of the active level editor viewport (e.g. Lit, Unlit,
Wireframe, Lighting-only, complexity visualizations).","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.SetViewportViewMode","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Toggles a named engine show flag on the active level editor viewport (e.g.
"Navigation", "Collision", "Grid", "Bounds", "Fog", "Landscape", "Volumes").","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.SetShowFlag","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Sets the location of the editor's transform-gizmo pivot.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.SetPivotLocation","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Activates the specified editor mode. Pass "EM_Default" (or an empty string) to
return to the default placement/select mode. Cannot be used during PIE.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.SetEditorMode","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Navigates the active content browser to the specified folder path.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.SetContentBrowserPath","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Sets the position and/or rotation of the level viewport camera. Anything not provided keeps its
current value.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.SetCameraTransform","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Selects the specified folders in every open scene outliner. Replaces the
existing folder selection; non-folder selections (e.g. selected actors)
are preserved.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.SelectOutlinerFolders","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Selects the specified assets in the content browser.
Completes once the content browser has applied the selection.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.SelectAssets","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Sets what is selected inside the asset editor for the given asset, replacing the current
selection. Supported for Blueprint editors (graph nodes) and Widget editors (widgets and graph
nodes); raises for material editors and other asset types whose selection cannot be set.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.SelectAssetEditorObjects","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Selects the specified actors in the current scene.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.SelectActors","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Finds the world position of the nearest solid object at a given set of normalized view space coords.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.ScreenCoordsToWorld","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Removes assets from the specified collection.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.RemoveAssetsFromCollection","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Opens an asset editor for the specified asset.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.OpenEditorForAsset","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Lists every engine show flag with its display name and editor group.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.ListShowFlags","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Lists the IDs of all registered editor modes (e.g. "EM_Default",
"EM_Landscape", "EM_Foliage"), ordered by mode priority.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.ListEditorModes","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Lists all collections in the content browser.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.ListCollections","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"True for active PIE or simulation, including online login before world creation.
A queued start alone returns false.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.IsPIERunning","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns all actors in the current level whose bounds intersect the viewport frustum.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.GetVisibleActors","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Reads whether a named engine show flag is currently enabled on the active level
editor viewport.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.GetShowFlag","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Gets the folder paths selected across all open scene outliners.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.GetSelectedOutlinerFolders","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Gets the list of assets selected in the content browser.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.GetSelectedAssets","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Gets the currently selected actors in the level editor.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.GetSelectedActors","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Gets the current location of the editor's transform-gizmo pivot.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.GetPivotLocation","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Gets the list of assets currently open in asset editors.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.GetOpenAssets","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Gets the current path of the active content browser.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.GetContentBrowserPath","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns the assets in the specified collection.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.GetCollectionAssets","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns the position and rotation of the level viewport camera.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.GetCameraTransform","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns the assets' existing cached thumbnails (the images the Content Browser shows) without
loading or rendering the assets.

On success the result's value holds one image per requested path, in request order; an entry is
an empty image when the asset has no saved thumbnail or its thumbnail could not be decoded. The
call completes with an error instead if any requested path cannot be found.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.GetAssetThumbnails","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Gets what is selected inside the asset editor for the given asset (e.g. selected graph nodes
in a Blueprint or Material editor, selected widgets in a UMG editor, and objects shown in the
editor's details panels). This is distinct from level-actor selection (GetSelectedActors) and
content-browser selection (GetSelectedAssets).","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.GetAssetEditorSelection","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns the IDs of the currently active editor modes. More than one mode can
be active at once; the default placement mode ("EM_Default") is usually present.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.GetActiveEditorModes","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Repositions the level editor camera to focus on the specified actors.
Cannot be called while PIE is active.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.FocusOnActors","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Requests a shutdown of the editor application. The request is queued for the next editor tick so
this call can return first; the process then exits and no further tool calls are possible.
Errors if any level or content package has unsaved changes and bDiscardUnsavedChanges is false.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.ExitEditor","annotations":{"accessMode":"execute"}},{"description":"Deletes the specified collection.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.DestroyCollection","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Creates a new static collection.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.CreateCollection","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Closes every asset editor open for the specified asset.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.CloseEditorForAsset","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Captures an image of the entire editor application as the user sees it.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.CaptureEditorImage","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Renders a thumbnail for the specified asset (e.g. static meshes, skeletal meshes,
skeletons, animations, montages, materials, textures).","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.CaptureAssetImage","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Adds assets to the specified collection.","name":"EditorToolset.EditorAppToolset.AddAssetsToCollection","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}}]},"EditorToolset.ObjectToolset":{"name":"EditorToolset.ObjectToolset","version":"1.0","description":"Inspects and modifies the properties of Unreal Objects and Classes, including those defined by
Blueprints, and discovers classes and subclasses.","tools":[{"description":"Sets the values of properties on an object.","name":"EditorToolset.ObjectToolset.SetProperties","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Finds all subclasses of a given class.","name":"EditorToolset.ObjectToolset.SearchSubclasses","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Resets one or more properties on an object to their default values, removing any
per-instance overrides.","name":"EditorToolset.ObjectToolset.ResetProperties","annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Returns the property names on an object as dotted paths relative to Root, one element per property MaxDepth reaches,
parents before children, without types or descriptions (GetPropertySchema has those). A struct cut by MaxDepth ends
in " {...}". A container's bracket reports its live occupancy: "[0..2]" for array indices, ["Alpha", "Beta"] for map
keys, a bare count for a set (never indexable), "[]" when empty, and "[?]" below an unsubscripted container, where no
instance reaches. Narrow a range or key list to one entry before passing a path to GetProperties or SetProperties.

An object reference is a leaf: to list the object it points at, such as a component, pass that object as Instance.","name":"EditorToolset.ObjectToolset.ListProperties","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns a JSON Schema of the properties on an object, with each property's type and description. Much larger
than ListProperties, so find the property there and come here only when its type is needed.

A schema describes types rather than an instance, so Root cannot carry a subscript.","name":"EditorToolset.ObjectToolset.GetPropertySchema","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns the values of one or more properties on an object.","name":"EditorToolset.ObjectToolset.GetProperties","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Returns the class of an Unreal object, resolving a Blueprint to its generated class and
returning a class unchanged.","name":"EditorToolset.ObjectToolset.GetClass","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}}]}},"errors":{}}
